title: Matched contextual preflop action-prior mechanism smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Small public-state SB-open and BB-facing-open class priors can counter the current-v6 source policy preflop aggression collapse while preserving postflop behavior and the source execution contract better than an otherwise identical zero-prior continuation.
material_change: Run matched two-iteration continuations from the frozen current-v6 soup with fresh optimizer/counters, identical duplicate-soup plus 50% procedural rollouts, source KL 0.1, seeds/deals and assignment schedule. Treatment alone enables coefficient 0.01 contextual priors at SB first action and BB facing one aggressive open.
baseline: Frozen source soup current-v6 greedy fresh20k is -41.8162 bb/100. Its Slumbot corpus exposes severe preflop aggression; an otherwise identical 65k mixed-curriculum continuation scored -107.0664 fresh5k. Context-specific priors have no prior experiment evidence.

notes: Preregistered health gate: both arms reach the same iteration/physical threshold, exact source hash, fresh optimizer/counters, identical local-index opponent assignments, only allowed policy/value tensors change, finite contextual-prior metrics and zero KL stops.

Mechanism gate is outcome-blind on the frozen source Slumbot state corpus: treatment must reduce excessive contextual greedy raise mass/frequency versus matched control, keep postflop treatment-minus-control mean TV within 0.005, and keep overall source-parent TV/disagreement at or below 0.02. No Slumbot performance test from this smoke.
Matched control reached iter2 with 8,775 physical/8,260 transition hands, fresh optimizer, max displayed source KL 0.0012 and zero KL stops.
Both fixed-pool session audits PASS; optimizer steps are matched at 60 and both assignment chains contain exactly two verified rows.

Independent terminal review PASS: checkpoint hashes, both session audits, exact normalized assignment schedules, 60,671 raw rows and aggregates, tensor scope, and failed mechanism gate were recomputed. Full alpha_holdem suite: 174 passed.

result.summary: Matched 8k-per-arm smoke completed 17,542 physical hands. Context priors reduced SB greedy raise frequency from 99.83% to 99.38% and BB-vs-open from 94.98% to 89.80%; overall treatment-parent TV/disagreement stayed 0.01718/0.01610, but postflop treatment-control TV was 0.02031 versus the preregistered 0.005 ceiling.
result.conclusion: The contextual prior is a real and directionally useful preflop gradient signal, especially for BB defense, but all-policy-head PPO changes the postflop head enough that the preregistered isolation gate fails. This endpoint is not eligible for scaling or Slumbot evaluation.
result.next_step: Implement and unit-test a preflop-head-only training mode that freezes the postflop policy head and shared trunk, then repeat the matched 8k mechanism smoke. Admit a larger pilot only if postflop execution is exactly preserved while contextual raise collapse improves.
